# BOOM

BOOM (Business Operations & Optimization Management) is a self-hosted and customizable business operations platform.

## Core product facts
- Product name: BOOM
- Product site: https://boom.yniidi.com/
- Category: business operations platform / ERP alternative
- Delivery model: one-time license and self-hosted deployment
- Main modules: orders, inventory, purchases, customers, suppliers, payments, analytics, tasks, and role-based access

## Recommended canonical pages
- Home: https://boom.yniidi.com/
- Features: https://boom.yniidi.com/features/
- Industries: https://boom.yniidi.com/industries/
- Pricing: https://boom.yniidi.com/pricing/
- Security: https://boom.yniidi.com/security/
- Deployment: https://boom.yniidi.com/deployment/
- Contact: https://boom.yniidi.com/contact/

## Positioning summary
BOOM helps operations-heavy teams replace spreadsheets and disconnected tools with one integrated system that they own and control.
